Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```
Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
Climb1 <- read.csv("data/Kyn1/kyn_slopes_concatenated.csv")#9:30am  8/1/23
Climb1b <- read.csv("data/Kyn1/kyn_individual_slopes.csv")#9:30am  8/1/23 individuals
Key<-read.csv("data/Kyn1/Kyn1Lifespan.csv")
Masses <- read.csv("data/Kyn1/kyn masses.csv")
Key<-Key %>% select("vialID","Treatment","sex","dateEclosed")
Key <- Key[-c(99:102), ]


Climb <- merge(Climb1,Key,by=c("vialID"))
Climbind <- merge(Climb1b,Key,by=c("vialID"))
Climb$sex<-as.factor(Climb$sex)
Climbind$sex<-as.factor(Climbind$sex)
Climb$Treatment<-as.factor(Climb$Treatment)
Climbind$Treatment<-as.factor(Climbind$Treatment)
```


Compute means
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
Climb%>%group_by(vial_ID,Trial) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    Trial=Trial,
    batch = batch,
    group=group,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    intercept = mean(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))->Climb_Mean
Climb%>%group_by(vial_ID,Trial) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    Trial=Trial,
    group=group,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    intercept = mean(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))->Climb_Mean2
Climb%>%group_by(vial_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    batch = batch,
    group=group,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    intercept = mean(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))->Climb_MeanTrial
Climb_Mean<-distinct(Climb_Mean)
Climb_Mean2<-distinct(Climb_Mean2)
Climb_MeanTrial<-distinct(Climb_MeanTrial)

Climb_Mean$group<-factor(Climb_Mean$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5 mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
Climb_Mean2$group<-factor(Climb_Mean2$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5 mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
Climb_MeanTrial$group<-factor(Climb_MeanTrial$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5 mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))

DMSO<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(Treatment=="DMSO")
TDOlow<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(group=="1")
TDOmid<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(group=="2")
TDOhigh<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(group=="3")

```

Climbing by Vial
```{r}
ggboxplot(Climb %>% filter(Treatment!= "Kynurenine"), x = "Treatment", y = "slope",
          color = "sex", #palette = c("black", "red"),
          add = "jitter")+
  facet_grid(~dateEclosed)+
  ggtitle("Climbing by Treatment")

levels(Climb$Treatment)
```

Climbing by Individual
```{r}
ggboxplot(Climbind %>% filter(Treatment!= "Kynurenine"), x = "Treatment", y = "slope",
          color = "sex", #palette = c("black", "red"),
          add = "jitter")+
  facet_grid(~dateEclosed)+
  ggtitle("Climbing by Individual")

```


ANOVAS
```{r}
summary(aov(slope ~ Treatment*sex+dateEclosed, data = Climb))
summary(aov(slope ~ Treatment*sex+dateEclosed, data = Climbind))

```


```{r}
ClimbMass <- merge(Masses,Key,by=c("vialID"))
ClimbMass <- ClimbMass %>% select(vialID, mass, N, AgeD, dateEclosed.x, Treatment, sex, dateEclosed.y) %>% mutate(avgmass = mass/N)
ClimbMass$sex<-as.factor(ClimbMass$sex)
ClimbMass$Treatment<-as.factor(ClimbMass$Treatment)
```

```{r}
ggboxplot(ClimbMass, x = "Treatment", y = "avgmass", 
          color = "sex", #palette = c("black", "red"),
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("AvgMass by Treatment")

```
```{r}
summary(aov(avgmass ~ Treatment*sex, data = ClimbMass))

```

```{r}
ClimbMass%>%group_by(Treatment,sex) %>%
  summarise(
  Treatment=Treatment,
  sex=sex,
    mass = mean(avgmass, na.rm = TRUE))->ClimbMass2
Climb<- merge(ClimbMass2,Climb,by=c("sex","Treatment"))
```


```{r}
ggplot(Climb, aes(x=mass, y=slope, color=sex)) + geom_point()

summary(aov(slope ~ mass, data = Climb))
cor(Climb$mass,Climb$slope)

summary(aov(slope ~ Treatment*mass, data = Climb))
```
